name: covis
description: Co-visibility graph + solve-validity gate from a COLMAP sparse/0 (STO-SCN-093). Emits per-image coverage, per-pair shared-point count + mean triangulation angle, and connectivity (covis_graph.py), plus the planarity nebula verdict (validity_gate.py). HARD-FAILS on a nebula so a failed solve never reaches selection (STO-SCN-094). Reads the COLMAP .bin files directly (FastMap output isn't pycolmap/model_analyzer-friendly). Lives under the solve it derives from.

min_overlap.note: shared-point threshold for the connectivity graph
